callouts.text: Choose File selects the release ZIP landing-page-manager.zip from your computer.
Select Install Now after choosing the ZIP to install it.
Help, at the bottom right of every Landing Page Manager screen, opens notes for that screen.
Open the user guide opens this screen's section of the guide in a new tab.
Add Landing Page opens the landing-page editor.
All Landing Pages opens the page list.
Clients opens the client list.
Open Dashboard opens the plugin dashboard.
Add Landing Page opens the landing-page editor.
Collapse or expand the Landing Page Manager Stats widget.
Enter a client name in Name.
Open Branding & Identity.
Open Contact Info.
Open Tracking & Integration.
Open Social Media.
Enter a keyword in Name.
Select Add New Keyword to add it to the list.
Name changes the keyword label.
Update saves the edited keyword.
Add New Landing Page opens the page editor.
The All Clients dropdown filters the page list by client.
Export CSV downloads the filtered list for administrators.
Title supplies the page's path slug.
Client Name assigns the page to a client.
Keyword assigns the campaign or search term.
Select Analytics in the Landing Pages menu to open this Pro-gated screen.
Select a template card to choose the site-wide template.
Contact for early access opens the plugin's configured Pro enquiry link.
Google Maps browser key is visible in page source and should be restricted to your site and client subdomains.
Google Maps server key is used for server-side lookups and should be restricted by server IP.
The Updates tab names GitHub Releases as the update source and points you to Dashboard → Updates → Check again to check now.
Deactivate turns off the plugin without deleting its settings or content.
